Definition: from τέφρα (ashes); to incinerate, i.e. consume:--turn to ashes.
BiblicalUsage: tephróō is the word for turn to ashes. In 2 Peter 2:6, turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow.
TheologicalSignificance: Sodom turned to ashes tells me God's judgment is no empty threat, and I take that warning to heart.
